svg.title: World map
svg.desc: An overworld map of the journey so far. JUL 2024: Made the account (then 19 quiet months) → MAR 2026: First repos public (Flask app + PWA in 48h) → JUN 2026: Two internships (Litmus7 · Cognifyz) → AUG 2026: 3 apps in 3 days (all live on Vercel) → SEP 2026: Campus Hub (~10k lines in a week) → NOW: Boss stage (boat safety system)
